originalSourceText:
Q.1  Why is face cropping performed before DeepFace processing?

         (A) To convert speech into text

          (B) To isolate the facial region that is relevant for emotion analysis

          (C) To convert RGB information into depth information

         (D) To publish the image directly to the ROS2 topic

          Explanation: Face detection identifies the region of interest, after which the cropped
            facial image is processed for emotion estimation.

          Refer slide10 of lecture 56: Demonstration of AI in Humanoid Robot
